name: App opens on the Route Analysis page and shows the model details
detail: URL /analysis; model strip: MODEL RandomForestClassifier TRAINING ROWS 12000 ACCURACY 85.5%

name: An example trip fills in the form with one click
detail: Origin "Copenhagen", destination "Roskilde"

name: The swap button swaps the start point and destination
detail: After swap: "Roskilde" to "Copenhagen"

name: The date picker only offers today and the next six days
A visitor who is not logged in can analyse a route (Copenhagen to Roskilde)
detail: 35.6043 km, grade Moderate, not saved, "Save this result" prompt shown

name: A departure date in the past is refused with a clear message
detail: HTTP 400: "That date has already passed. Pick a day between 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-17."

name: A date beyond the forecast window is refused with a clear message
detail: HTTP 400: "The weather forecast only reaches 2026-11-17, and this app will not grade a route without a real forecast behind it. Pick a day between 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-17."

name: An unknown place name gives a readable error message
detail: HTTP 404, message shown: "Route not found. Could not match "Qwxyzborg Nowhere" to a place in Denmark. Try a more specific Denmark town, address or postcode. Check the spelling of both places."

name: Use My Location fills the start point from the device position
detail: Position set to Copenhagen City Hall Square; origin became "Vestervold, Meatpacking District, Copenhagen, Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, 1550, Denmark"

name: A new user can sign up and is logged in straight away
detail: Redirected to /profile; top bar shows "Test Driver"

name: Signing up again with the same email is refused with a clear message
detail: Message: "An account with that email already exists."

name: A wrong password gives a general message that does not reveal whether the email exists
detail: Both a wrong password and an unknown email show "Invalid email or password."

name: A registered user can log in and is sent to the Route Analysis page
detail: Redirected to /analysis; top bar shows "Test Driver"

name: A logged-in user analyses Copenhagen to Aarhus for tomorrow at 08:00 and gets the full result
detail: 303.3325 km, 205.01000000000002 min, grade Good (50%), leave 15 min early; 19 features, 34 directions, 9 factor rows, probabilities add to 100.10000000000001%; saved as history item 1

name: Feedback can be given on a fresh advisory
detail: Feedback saved successfully.

name: Six more routes of different lengths and times are analysed without errors
detail: Odense-Aarhus 144.90189999999998 km Good, 4 events; Aalborg-Aarhus 121.2196 km Moderate, 0 events; Copenhagen Airport-Odense 170.9596 km Good, 8 events; Esbjerg-Kolding 75.5562 km Moderate, 2 events; Roskilde-Køge 25.3383 km Moderate, 1 events; Helsingør-Copenhagen 45.544599999999996 km Moderate, 1 events

name: The History page lists saved analyses newest first, and feedback can be saved there
detail: 7 saved analyses, newest first ("Helsingør → København" at the top); 2 marked "Review saved"

name: The profile can be edited and the change is kept after a reload
detail: Message "Profile updated successfully."; phone still 20304060 after reload

name: Logged-out visitors are sent to the login page when they open History
detail: Redirected to /login?returnUrl=%2Fhistory

name: The history API refuses a request without a login token
detail: HTTP 401

name: The ML service answers a prediction quickly (20 timed requests)
detail: median 40 ms, slowest 49 ms

name: The app works on a phone-sized screen (Pixel 7 size)
detail: Result shown; no sideways scrolling (overflow 0px)

name: Turn-by-turn guidance shows the next instruction and distance and spots leaving the route
detail: Next instruction "Continue on Vester Farimagsgade" in 560 m; after moving away: "You have left the route. You are 260 m from it — rejoin it when it is safe."

name: With the ML service stopped, the app explains that grading failed instead of crashing
detail: HTTP 502; advisory card says: "Road-condition grading failed. The road-condition model service is unavailable. Start the Python ml-service on port 8000."
